paper_title: Efficient Ensemble for Fine-tuning Language Models on Multiple Datasets
caption: This figure compares the error rate (one average minus test accuracy), computation cost, and GPU memory across our approach and baselines, for fine-tuning Llama-3-8B on ten NLP tasks with QAdapter.
model_annotation: This bar chart, titled "QAdapter," illustrates the GPU memory consumption in gigabytes (GB) across different fine-tuning methods for a language model. The horizontal axis contains six categorical labels displayed at an angle: "Full FT," "MTL-FT," "TAG," "Adapter," "QAdapter," and "Ours." The vertical axis is labeled "GPU Memory (GB)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 80 GB, with gridlines visible at intervals of 20 GB. Five of the six bars are colored orange, while the final bar labeled "Ours" is colored dark green and its label appears in bold text, visually distinguishing it from the other methods. The tallest bar is "Full FT," reaching approximately 73 GB, followed by "MTL-FT" at approximately 43 GB. The "TAG" bar is approximately 19 GB, "Adapter" is approximately 17 GB, and "QAdapter" is the shortest bar at approximately 9 GB. The "Ours" bar reaches approximately 19 GB. The bars appear to be arranged in a roughly descending order from left to right with the exception of the "Ours" bar, which is slightly taller than the preceding "QAdapter" bar.
